- Each script exposes a `main()` function that parses `process.argv`, prints help on `-h/--help`, and invokes the appropriate command handler, with top-level `.catch(err => { console.error(...); process.exit(1); })` for unhandled rejections.
- Repository discovery is centralized in `git-utils.getRepos()` which reads `.gitmodules` and validates each submodule's `.git` directory before returning the list consumed by all Git batch scripts.
- Git commands are executed via a small wrapper that promisifies `child_process.exec`/`execFile` and passes `{ cwd: repoPath }` so every operation runs against the target repository rather than the scripts directory.
- User-facing output uses emoji-prefixed status lines (✅, ⚠️, ❌, 📦, 🔀, etc.) consistently across all scripts to distinguish success, warnings, errors, and informational messages.
- Batch operations iterate over all discovered repos, collect per-repo results into an array, and print a summary table at the end showing counts of successes, skips, conflicts, and errors.
- Optional flags like `-S/--stash`, `-P/--pop`, `--dry-run`, `--auto-continue`, `--token/--title` are parsed with simple `args.includes(...)` / index lookups and passed as an options object to the core workflow functions.
